bounds.domain: One plugin registration, one polling owner, one activation callback, one permanent stop epoch and at most one poll-query failure. Requirement checks, polling queries and the activation microtask keep separate boundaries.
assumptions: When secrets remain available, ReadySettles assumes weak fairness of enabled polling, query settlement, activation dispatch and callback completion. One allowed query failure may occur before success; repeated permanent provider failures are outside this finite bound. ReadyWithoutFairness must produce a stuttering counterexample.

Stop blocks new activation callbacks and new timers. It waits for callbacks that already began; this model does not undo their external effects. A registration awaiting requirements may settle after stop but cannot recreate pending work.

Multiple plugins, activation-callback rejection and retries, reinitializing the same retired service, arbitrary secret values and all listener/onSecretsReady effects are outside this instance. Callback completion is assumed; no external effect or exactly-once retry guarantee is proved. The production service test uses a controlled Secrets port and deterministic timers for the stop race; it is not an external plugin-effect acceptance test.
